name: Dangamronba - דן גם רון בא
source:
Meet the Tikva Unit, an elite unit of the IDF.

This unit has the best soldiers from every corps. From every field in the IDF, the best soldiers are selected and brought to this unit. Soldiers who enlist in the unit perform basic training once again.

But when fifteen new soldiers who are supposed to pass basic training arrive, they discover that everything is not that simple.

[Translated from [url=https://dryonatan.itch.io/dangamronba]itch.io[/url]]
